title: GPU-only MTBF vs fleet size
caption: The 50,000 h per-GPU MTTF divided by fleet size: a job's expected GPU-failure cadence halves with every doubling. The full-system cascade (PCIe, NIC, power shares) lands lower still — about 3.9 h at 10,000 — and measured production cadences sit near 3.1 h on 16,384 GPUs.

title: Llama 3: 419 interruptions by cause
caption: Meta's Llama 3 405B pretraining log, grouped from Table 5 of the run report. GPU components dominate (~64%); software bugs and failed dependencies, network, and host work share most of the rest. Silent data corruption appears only where detected (6).
